records.name: Grant Medical College Mumbai
records.description: Grant Medical College Mumbai, established in 1845, is one of the oldest and most prestigious medical institutions in Asia, affiliated with Maharashtra University of Health Sciences. It is attached to the historic Sir Jamshedjee Jejeebhoy (JJ) Group of Hospitals, providing vast clinical exposure to students. Grant Medical College offers MBBS and postgraduate programs and has a strong legacy of producing eminent physicians and surgeons.

records.name: Government Dental College Mumbai
records.description: Government Dental College and Hospital Mumbai is one of the oldest dental colleges in India, established in 1938, and affiliated with Maharashtra University of Health Sciences. It offers BDS and MDS programs with strong clinical training at its attached hospital serving thousands of patients from across the Mumbai Metropolitan Region. The college has produced leading dental practitioners and academics who have shaped oral health education in India.

records.name: National Institute of Sports Patiala
records.description: National Institute of Sports (NIS) Patiala is India's premier sports coaching and physical education institution, often called the 'Mecca of Indian sports.' Established in 1961, it offers diploma and certificate programs in coaching across 30+ sports disciplines and is affiliated with the Netaji Subhas National Institute of Sports. NIS Patiala has trained thousands of coaches and physical education teachers who serve at state and national levels across India.

records.name: Institute of Hotel Management Delhi
records.description: Institute of Hotel Management (IHM) Delhi, established in 1962, is one of India's premier hotel management institutions under the National Council for Hotel Management (NCHMCT). It offers three-year B.Sc. programs in Hospitality and Hotel Administration and is known for producing graduates who lead hospitality operations at five-star hotels, cruise lines, and international hotel chains. IHM Delhi has strong placement links with leading global hospitality brands including Marriott, Hyatt, and Taj Hotels.

records.name: IHM Mumbai
records.description: Institute of Hotel Management Catering Technology and Applied Nutrition (IHM) Mumbai is one of India's oldest and most prestigious hotel management institutions, affiliated with NCHMCT. It offers the three-year B.Sc. in Hospitality and Hotel Administration and is renowned for its state-of-the-art training kitchen, bakery, and front office labs. IHM Mumbai alumni lead operations at major hotel chains and have founded some of India's most recognized restaurant groups.

records.name: IHM Bangalore
records.description: Institute of Hotel Management (IHM) Bangalore is a top-ranked central government hotel management institution offering B.Sc. in Hospitality and Hotel Administration under NCHMCT. Located in India's Silicon Valley, it benefits from proximity to the booming Bengaluru hospitality and F&B industry, offering students exceptional internship and placement opportunities. IHM Bangalore is known for its modern culinary labs, industry-integrated training, and international exchange programs.

records.name: Oberoi Centre of Learning and Development
records.description: Oberoi Centre of Learning and Development (OCLD) New Delhi is the exclusive training school of The Oberoi Group, one of India's finest luxury hotel chains. It offers a highly selective postgraduate management trainee program that combines academic instruction with hands-on training at Oberoi properties across India. OCLD is regarded as the gold standard for luxury hospitality education in India, and its graduates are placed across The Oberoi Group's properties worldwide.

records.name: National Institute of Event Management (NIEM)
records.description: National Institute of Event Management (NIEM) Mumbai is one of India's pioneering event management education institutions, offering diploma, postgraduate, and certificate programs in event management, wedding planning, and entertainment management. It has trained thousands of event professionals who now work across corporate events, entertainment, sports, and social event industries. NIEM maintains industry partnerships with leading event companies for practical training and placement.

records.name: Gujarat Ayurved University
records.description: Gujarat Ayurved University (GAU) in Jamnagar is India's first and premier Ayurveda university, established in 1967, and home to the internationally acclaimed Jamnagar IPGT&RA (Institute of Post Graduate Teaching and Research in Ayurveda). It offers BAMS, MD Ayurveda, and Ph.D. programs and is a World Health Organization collaborating center for traditional medicine. GAU is the apex institution for Ayurvedic research and clinical training in India.

records.name: National Institute of Homoeopathy
records.description: National Institute of Homoeopathy (NIH) Kolkata is the apex government institution for homoeopathic education in India, functioning under the Ministry of AYUSH. It offers BHMS (undergraduate), MD (Homoeopathy), and Ph.D. programs with state-of-the-art laboratories and a large attached teaching hospital. NIH is considered the benchmark for homoeopathic education quality in India and contributes to standardization of homoeopathic curricula across the country.
